title: AI 리드 응답 자동화 시스템
summary: 문의가 들어오면 자동으로 긴급도를 분류하고, 맞춤 메시지와 요약 링크까지 자동으로 제안하는 프롬프트.
prompt: You are an AI sales operations manager. For each lead provided, return a table with: 1) Intent classification 2) Urgency level (P0/P1/P2) 3) Personalized follow-up message under 80 words 4) Best CTA (book a call / send pricing / nurture) 5) CRM note. Keep replies short — shorter responses convert better.

title: 고객 지원 티켓 자동 분류
summary: 지원 티켓을 자동 분류하고, 공개 열린 첫 응답 이슈를 생성하며, 에스컬레이션이 필요한 건을 탐지.
prompt: You are a customer support triage agent. For each ticket: identify category (billing, bug, feature request, account, other), sentiment (frustrated/neutral/positive), priority, and write a draft first reply that acknowledges the issue, sets expectations, and asks one clarifying question if needed. Flag tickets that require human escalation.

title: 회의록 → 액션 아이템 자동 정리
summary: 회의 트랜스크립트를 깔끔한 요약, 결정 사항, 담당자, 마감일로 변환.
prompt: You are an executive assistant. From the transcript below, output: (1) 3-sentence summary, (2) key decisions made, (3) action items as a table with Owner / Task / Due date / Dependencies, (4) open questions for next meeting. Ignore filler and small talk.

title: 받은편지함 데일리 브리핑
summary: 하루 이메일을 유형별로 묶어 5분 안에 읽는 아침 브리핑 + 우선 답장 이슈 작성.
prompt: You are my chief of staff. Read the emails below and produce a morning brief: (1) Top 3 items needing my decision today, (2) Drafts for replies I should send (under 60 words each), (3) Items safe to archive, (4) Items to delegate with suggested delegate. Output in markdown sections.

title: Zapier/Make 워크플로우 설계
summary: 비즈니스 프로세스를 자연어로 입력하면 자동화 플로우(트리거·필터·액션)를 설계해줌.
prompt: You are a no-code automation architect. Given the process below, design a Zapier or Make workflow: list triggers, filters, paths, actions, error handling, and required data fields per step. Note any step that requires custom code or webhooks. Output as a numbered flow plus a short ROI estimate.

title: Loom 영상 → SOP 문서화
summary: 화면 녹화 트랜스크립트를 스크린샷 위치까지 명시된 표준 운영 절차서로 변환.
prompt: You are a documentation specialist. From the recording transcript below, generate an SOP with: title, purpose, prerequisites, numbered steps (imperative voice), screenshots needed (describe each), troubleshooting section, and 'when to escalate'. Keep each step under 20 words.

title: CRM 데이터 정리 어시스턴트
summary: CRM 내보내기 파일에서 중복을 찾고 필드를 정규화하며 병합 규칙을 제안.
prompt: You are a RevOps data analyst. From the CSV rows below, identify: (1) duplicate contacts (with confidence score), (2) merge rules (which record wins per field), (3) missing critical fields, (4) suggested validation rules to prevent future issues. Output a cleanup plan and the cleaned rows.

title: 콜드 이메일 5단계 시퀀스
summary: 타깃 퍼르소나에 맞춘 5번 점점 세지는 시퀀스 + A/B 제목 자동 작성.
prompt: You are an outbound sales strategist. For the target persona below, write a 5-touch sequence (email-email-LinkedIn-email-breakup). Each email: subject line A, subject line B, 70-word body, one CTA, personalization slot. Tone: human, specific, no buzzwords. Output as a table.

title: 인보이스 미납금 리마인더
summary: 연체 일수와 고객 등급에 따라 톤이 달라지는 미납금 리마인더 메일을 자동 작성.
prompt: You are a friendly AR specialist. Given an invoice age and customer tier, draft the appropriate reminder email: 3 days overdue (gentle), 14 days (firm), 30 days (formal with consequences), 60 days (final notice). Include payment link placeholder and option to discuss. Match tone to tier (SMB vs Enterprise).

title: 슬랙 데일리 스탠드업 요약
summary: 비동기 스탠드업 스레드를 한 줄 전체 상태 다이제스트 한 장으로 압축.
prompt: You are a team operations bot. From the standup thread below, produce a team digest: (1) shipped yesterday, (2) shipping today, (3) blockers (with @mentions for who can unblock), (4) team morale signal. Keep total under 200 words. Use bullet points only.

title: 유튜브 쇼츠 파이프라인 설계
summary: 롱폼 스크립트에서 쇼츠 후보 5개를 추출하고 훅, 썸네일, 제목까지 자동 작성.
prompt: You are a YouTube growth strategist. From the long-form script below, extract 5 Shorts candidates. For each: hook line (first 3 seconds), thumbnail text (max 4 words), 3 title options, captions emphasis points. Optimize for saves and rewatches over raw views.

title: 바이럴 제목 & 썸네일 생성기
summary: 검증된 호기심 갭 패턴을 사용해 10개의 제목·썸네일 조합을 작성.
prompt: You are a YouTube packaging expert. For the video topic below, generate 10 title + thumbnail copy pairs. Use curiosity gap, contrast, specificity, and outcome framing. Avoid clickbait that doesn't deliver. Rank them by predicted CTR and explain the pattern used in each.

title: 리텐션 훅 포함 영상 스크립트
summary: 90초마다 시청 유지를 위한 훅이 배치된 롱폼 영상 스크립트 작성.
prompt: You are a long-form video scriptwriter. For the topic below, write a 10-minute script with: cold open hook (15s), value promise, 6 sections each ending with an open loop, mid-roll re-engagement, strong outro CTA. Mark every 90 seconds with a visual change cue.

title: 유튜브 채널 니치 감사
summary: 채널 포지셔닝, 경쟁 채널 갭, 30일 콘텐츠 플랜까지 한 번에 분석.
prompt: You are a YouTube channel strategist. Given the channel description and last 10 videos below: (1) identify the current niche, (2) score positioning clarity 1-10, (3) find 3 competitor gaps, (4) propose a 30-day content plan with title ideas, (5) recommend a single content pillar to double down on.

title: B-roll 샷 리스트 작성
summary: 완성된 스크립트에서 타임스탬프별 B-roll·사가 타 리스트를 자동 작성.
prompt: You are a video editor's assistant. From the script below, generate a shot list: timestamp, scene, B-roll suggestion, on-screen text, transition style, music mood. Include 3 alternative shots per scene. Output as a CSV-ready table.

title: 댓글 마이닝으로 영상 아이디어
summary: 유튜브 댓글을 테마별로 군집화해 시청자 핵심포인트와 다음 영상 아이디어 도출.
prompt: You are an audience research analyst. From the comments below, cluster them into 5-7 themes. For each theme: count, representative quote, sentiment, video idea it suggests, urgency. Output a prioritized content backlog.

title: 롱폼 영상 → 7개 포맷 재가공
summary: 긴 영상 하나를 쇼츠·트윗·링크드인·뉴스레터·블로그·캐러셀·팟캐스트 클립으로 자동 분해.
prompt: You are a content repurposing engine. From the long-form transcript below, produce: (1) 3 Shorts scripts, (2) 5 tweets (one as a thread starter), (3) one LinkedIn post (under 1300 chars), (4) newsletter section (300 words), (5) blog outline, (6) Instagram carousel (8 slides), (7) 60-second podcast clip pitch.

title: 스폰서십 피치 메일
summary: 브랜드 맞춤 스폰서십 제안 메일 — 시청자 적합도, 패키지 3단계, 실적 근거 포함.
prompt: You are a creator partnerships manager. Draft a sponsorship pitch to the brand below: subject line, 100-word personalized opener, audience demographics summary, 3 sponsorship package tiers with deliverables and pricing rationale, social proof, soft CTA to chat. Avoid template-y language.

title: 재사용 가능한 훅 라이브러리
summary: 성과 패턴별 20개 훅 템플릿 라이브러리 — 호기심·반발·문제 인식·선택 등.
prompt: You are a hook strategist. Generate 20 reusable hook templates organized by pattern (curiosity, controversy, contrarian, problem-aware, transformation, social proof). For each: template, fill-in slots, example for the niche below, when to use, when to avoid.

title: 챕터 마커 & SEO 설명란
summary: 트랜스크립트에서 정확한 챕터 마커, SEO 최적화 설명, 추천 태그 자동 작성.
prompt: You are a YouTube SEO specialist. From the transcript below, output: (1) chapter markers with timestamps and concise titles, (2) 200-word description with keywords naturally included, (3) 15 tags ranked by relevance, (4) suggested pinned comment that drives engagement.

title: 쿠팡/어필리에이트 상품 최적화
summary: 구매 의도에 맞는 비교형 클릭 전 카피로 어필리 전환율을 높이는 프롬프트.
prompt: You are an affiliate marketing consultant. For the product category below, produce: (1) comparison criteria, (2) top 5 product recommendations with pros/cons, (3) pre-click copy that handles objections, (4) review-style hooks, (5) FAQ section. Avoid hype — write from a real-user lens.

title: Best-of 리스티클 골격
summary: 구매 의도 키워드로 상위 노출되는 'Best [상품] 2026' 리스티클 구조 설계.
prompt: You are an affiliate SEO writer. For the keyword below, draft a listicle skeleton: H1, intro with promise, methodology section, 7 ranked picks (best overall, budget, premium, etc.), each with summary, pros, cons, who it's for, CTA placement. Add internal linking suggestions.

title: 신뢰감 있는 상품 리뷰 글
summary: 직접 써본 뷰어 키울로 신뢰를 쌓고 클릭을 유도하는 1500자 롱폼 리뷰.
prompt: You are a hands-on product reviewer. Write a 1500-word review of the product below: who it's for, unboxing impressions, daily use observations, head-to-head with one competitor, where it falls short, verdict score, who should NOT buy it. Insert affiliate CTAs naturally at 3 points.

title: 구매 의도 키워드 맵
summary: 니치를 정보형·비교형·거래형 3단계 키워드 클러스터로 자동 매핑.
prompt: You are an SEO researcher. For the niche below, generate a keyword map with 3 clusters: (1) informational (top of funnel), (2) commercial investigation (best/vs/review), (3) transactional (buy/discount/coupon). For each keyword: estimated intent, suggested article angle, internal link target.

title: FAQ 스키마 빌더
summary: 검색 스니펫과 상품 페이지 전환을 최적화하는 FAQ 콘텐츠 자동 작성.
prompt: You are an SEO content strategist. For the product/topic below, generate 10 FAQ Q&As optimized for featured snippets. Keep answers 40-60 words. Cover objections, comparisons, use cases, alternatives. Output as JSON-LD ready schema plus rendered HTML.

title: 언박싱 영상 스크립트
summary: 어필리 링크 노출 타이밍과 시청자 유지 비트가 명시된 7분 언박싱 스크립트.
prompt: You are an unboxing creator. Write a 7-minute unboxing script for the product below: hook, expectation reveal, unboxing beats (each with B-roll cue), feature spotlight (3 features), real-use test, verdict, CTA. Mark exact timestamps for affiliate link mentions and pinned comment cue.

title: 어필리 오퍼 3단 메일 캠페인
summary: 예고·론칭·라스트콜 3개의 메일로 구성된 어필리 오퍼 미니 캠페인.
prompt: You are an email copywriter. For the affiliate offer below, write 3 emails: (1) curiosity teaser day before, (2) launch day with full pitch, (3) last-call urgency. Each: subject line + preheader, 200-word body, P.S. with social proof, single CTA. Match the tone of an honest creator, not a hard seller.

title: 공정 규정 준수 카피 리라이트
summary: 설득력을 유지하면서 FTC·국내 광고 표현 규정에 맞게 카피를 다시 쓰기.
prompt: You are a compliance-aware copywriter. Review the copy below and: (1) flag any claims that need substantiation, (2) add proper affiliate disclosure language, (3) rewrite borderline claims to be honest and still compelling, (4) suggest where disclosure should appear visually. Provide before/after side-by-side.

title: 핀터레스트 핀 카피 & 전략
summary: 어필리 글 하나에 대해 SEO 설명까지 포함된 핀 10개 변형을 자동 작성.
prompt: You are a Pinterest marketing expert. For the article URL below, generate 10 pin variations: image concept, overlay text (max 8 words), pin title, 200-char description with keywords, board fit. Output as a table with predicted save rate and rationale.

title: 전환율 감사 체크리스트
summary: 어필리 페이지의 클릭률·구매 마찰 항목별로 진단하고 개선 우선순위 도출.
prompt: You are a CRO consultant. For the page content below, audit: (1) above-the-fold clarity, (2) CTA visibility and copy, (3) trust signals, (4) friction points, (5) mobile reading flow, (6) link placement strategy. Output a prioritized fix list with expected lift estimates.

title: SaaS 온보딩 이메일 7일 시퀀스
summary: 활성화 시점에 맞춘 7일 온보딩 + 성공 경로 포함 이메일 시퀀스.
prompt: You are a SaaS product marketer. Write a 7-day onboarding email sequence. Each email: subject, key message, single CTA, churn-prevention purpose. Lead with success outcomes before features. Include 1 personal-from-founder email and 1 case study email.

title: SaaS 가격 페이지 리라이트
summary: 가치 명확화와 의사결정 마찰 감소에 이점을 맞춘 가격 페이지 재구성.
prompt: You are a SaaS pricing strategist. Rewrite the pricing page below: clear plan names, who-it's-for line per tier, top 5 features per tier (no exhaustive lists), 3 anchor differentiators, FAQ addressing top 5 objections, single recommended plan with reasoning. Avoid feature-list arms race.

title: 신기능 출시 통합 안내
summary: 블로그·이메일·인앱·체인지로그까지 일관된 포지셔닝으로 출시 안내 작성.
prompt: You are a product marketing lead. For the feature below, write coordinated announcements: (1) blog post (600 words, problem-solution framing), (2) email to existing users, (3) in-app banner copy (max 60 chars), (4) changelog entry, (5) tweet thread (5 tweets). Keep positioning consistent across all.

title: 이탈 사전 인터뷰 분석
summary: 자본 해지 피드백을 군집화해 실행 가능한 이탈 버킷으로 정리.
prompt: You are a customer success analyst. From the cancellation feedback below, cluster reasons into 6-8 buckets. For each: count, representative verbatim, root cause hypothesis, prevention idea, win-back angle. Rank by frequency and revenue impact.

title: 사용자 인터뷰 질문 뱅크
summary: 디스커버리·온보딩·이탈 연구를 위한 리서치 등급 인터뷰 질문 세트.
prompt: You are a UX researcher. For the study goal below, generate 15 interview questions split into: warm-up, behavior probes, motivation probes, friction probes, magic-wand questions. Avoid leading questions. Include follow-up prompts for each. Add a screening question set.

title: 헬프 문서 자동 작성기
summary: 내부 기능 스펙을 고객용 헬프 센터 글로 변환하고 스크린샷 위치도 표시.
prompt: You are a technical writer. From the feature spec below, write a help article: title, who it's for, prerequisites, step-by-step (max 7 steps), expected result, troubleshooting (3 common issues), related articles. Note where screenshots are needed. Use plain language at a 7th-grade reading level.

title: 연간 결제 업셀 메일
summary: 월간 구독자에게 가치 중심·절약 긴급성으로 연간 전환을 유도하는 메일.
prompt: You are a SaaS lifecycle marketer. Write an upsell email targeting monthly subscribers active 3+ months. Lead with their usage milestones, frame annual savings as 2 free months, address commitment objection, soft urgency (offer ends in 14 days). Keep under 180 words. One CTA only.

title: 공개 로드맵 커뮤니케이션
summary: 내부 로드맵을 신뢰도 있고 과도한 약속을 피하는 공개 버전으로 변환.
prompt: You are a product communications lead. From the internal roadmap below, produce a public version with: Now / Next / Later columns, plain-English titles (no internal jargon), expected user benefit per item, what it explicitly does NOT include, comments-welcome CTA. Avoid dates; use directional language.

title: 세일즈 데모 스크립트
summary: ICP 세그먼트에 맞춰 적응하는 디스커버리 중심 25분 데모 스크립트.
prompt: You are a SaaS sales engineer. For the ICP below, create a 25-minute demo script: opening alignment (3 min), discovery questions (5 min), tailored demo path (12 min, mapped to discovery answers), objection-handling cues, close + next step (5 min). Annotate moments to pause and confirm value.

title: Git 커밋 → 체인지로그
summary: 원본 git log를 사용자 친화적인 카테고리별 릴리즈 노트로 변환.
prompt: You are a release notes writer. From the git log below, produce a changelog grouped into ✨ New, 📈 Improvements, 🐛 Fixes, 🔧 Under-the-hood. Translate technical commits to user-impact language. Skip internal-only changes. Add a one-line summary at the top.

title: 30일 콘텐츠 캘린더
summary: 플랫폼별 훅·CTA·재가공 타이밍까지 포함된 30일치 콘텐츠 캘린더 자동 작성.
prompt: You are a performance content strategist. Build a 30-day calendar from the brand info below. For each day: platform, format, hook, summary body, CTA, repurpose-from / repurpose-to links between posts. Aim for lead generation and consultation conversions over vanity metrics.

title: 트위터/X 스레드 빌더
summary: 강력한 훅과 북마크할 만한 마무리가 있는 9개 트윗 스레드 자동 작성.
prompt: You are a Twitter ghostwriter. For the topic below, write a 9-tweet thread: hook tweet (must work standalone), 7 value tweets (one insight each, bookmark-worthy), close tweet with soft CTA. Use line breaks for readability. Avoid emojis except where they replace words.

title: 링크드인 퍼스널 브랜딩 글
summary: 개인 스토리·인사이트·약한 거리 CTA를 담은 링크드인 1300자 포스트.
prompt: You are a LinkedIn ghostwriter. Write a 1300-character post on the topic below. Structure: pattern-interrupt opening line, personal story (3-4 short paragraphs), 3 takeaways formatted as a list, reflection question as CTA. Conversational tone. No #hashtag spam.

title: 인스타그램 캐러셀 10장
summary: 팔질 훅 + 가치 흐름 + 저장할 만한 요약으로 구성된 10장 캐러셀.
prompt: You are an Instagram content designer. For the topic below, write a 10-slide carousel: slide 1 cover hook (max 6 words), slides 2-9 progressive insights (one idea each, max 25 words), slide 10 summary + CTA. Add caption (150 words) with one question to drive comments.

title: 뉴스레터 한 호 구성
summary: 훅·메인 에세이·프레이즈 링크·구독자 전용 인사이트로 구성된 주간 뉴스레터.
prompt: You are a newsletter editor. For the theme below, outline this week's edition: subject line A/B, preheader, hook (50 words), main essay (500 words, one strong opinion), 3 curated links with 1-line takes, subscriber-only insider nugget, soft CTA. Voice: smart friend, not corporate.

title: 블로그 SEO 아웃라인
summary: H2/H3, 시맨틱 키워드, 검색 의도까지 반영한 검색 최적화 롱폼 블로그 골격.
prompt: You are an SEO content strategist. For the keyword below, build an outline: search intent type, H1, meta description, 6-8 H2 sections with H3 subpoints, semantic keywords to include, FAQ section, internal link suggestions, target word count, featured snippet target.

title: 팟캐스트 게스트 출연 피치
summary: 주제 최근성·영상 스토리·청중 적합성을 담은 팟캐스트 게스트 피치 메일.
prompt: You are a podcast booker. Draft a guest pitch to the show below: subject line, 80-word opener showing you've listened, 3 episode angles with sample story per angle, audience-fit reasoning, social proof, easy yes CTA. Sub-200 words total.

title: 스토리텔링 프레임 적용
summary: 밋밋한 콘텐츠를 StoryBrand·영웅의 여정 구조로 다시 쓰기.
prompt: You are a story-driven copywriter. Rewrite the content below using the StoryBrand framework: Customer as hero, problem (external/internal/philosophical), guide positioning, plan, call to action, success vision, failure stakes. Output the rewrite plus a one-paragraph rationale per choice.

title: 브랜드 보이스 가이드라인
summary: do/don't 예시까지 포함된 한 장 분량 브랜드 보이스 가이드 자동 작성.
prompt: You are a brand strategist. From the brand description below, produce a voice guideline: 3 voice attributes (we are X, not Y), tone modulation by channel, 5 do/don't sentence pairs, vocabulary preferences (use these words / avoid these words), example post-edit (before/after).

title: 콘텐츠 재가공 매트릭스
summary: 하나의 콘텐츠 1개를 12개 파생 콘텐츠로 자동 매핑하는 시스템.
prompt: You are a content systems designer. For the pillar content below, generate a repurposing matrix: 12 derivative pieces (Shorts, tweets, thread, LinkedIn, carousel, newsletter section, blog excerpt, podcast clip, quote graphic, FAQ post, case study, course module). For each: format, hook, target channel, expected effort 1-5.
